description: Send a signed 'webhook.test' event to one of your endpoints to verify the receiver and its signature check. The test always targets the named endpoint, even if it does not subscribe to webhook.test. Returns the deliveryId to inspect with get_webhook_delivery. Limited to 10 tests per hour. Requires RENTAHUMAN_API_KEY to be set.

endpointId.description: The ID of the webhook endpoint to test (from list_webhook_endpoints).

name: test_webhook_endpoint
